claims.explanation: Repaglinide is a meglitinide KATP-channel blocker and OATP substrate; its selective killing likely depends on tumor-cell expression of KATP channel subunits (ABCC8/KCNJ11 or ABCC9/KCNJ8) that trigger apoptosis upon channel closure, combined with OATP-mediated uptake (SLCO1B1/SLCO2B1/SLCO1B3) and CYP2C8-mediated metabolism. EGFR mutation may further mark sensitive lines, while NF2 loss may be protective.
